comment: The section equates the responder with the actor offering a service and the initiator with the actor requiring it. This terminology fits request-response transactions but may be misleading for event-driven or peer-to-peer interaction.

anchor.note: p.80-81 l.Lines 1026-1033 read as the printed page; section 3.7.2 agrees

public.text: The section equates the responder with the actor offering a service and the initiator with the actor requiring it. This terminology fits request-response transactions but may be misleading for event-driven or peer-to-peer interaction.
public.suggestedRevision: Use provider and consumer as the general service relationship, and apply initiator and responder only to transaction patterns where those roles are meaningful.
